map.不一定。BMI 不区分脂肪与肌肉，健身者可能 BMI 偏高却体脂低（假性超重）；: Not necessarily. BMI does not distinguish fat from muscle, so a fitness enthusiast may have a high BMI with low body fat (pseudo-overweight); conversely a "skinny fat" person may have a normal BMI but high visceral fat. Judge it together with waist circumference and body fat percentage.

map.亚洲人在较低 BMI 即出现代谢风险，故中国标准超重线 24、肥胖线 28，低于: Asian people develop metabolic risk at a lower BMI, so the Chinese standard sets the overweight line at 24 and the obesity line at 28, below the WHO 25/30; this tool uses the Chinese standard (18.5-23.9 normal).
